alignment: Source loci aligned by page and numeric locus. Report raw equality, textual equality after markup handling, missing loci and ambiguous variants separately. Inspect eight anchor occurrences in original-resolution images. Never force a geometric location from transcription agreement alone.
limits: No meaning assigned to any EVA form. Image agreement is a provisional assistant reading, not independent expert validation. Remaining lines are imported scholarly readings unless explicitly reviewed.
